meanings: 【名詞】舌（口の中にある筋肉器官）the muscle in your mouth used for tasting, swallowing, and speaking
【名詞】言語、言葉。特に母国語を指す a language, especially one's native language（…mother tongue…）
【名詞】舌のような形をしたもの。長く細い突出部 a long narrow part of something shaped like a tongue（…a tongue of stone…）
【動詞】舌で触れる、なめる to touch or lick with the tongue

examples.ipa: /ðə ˈfrɑɡz ˈtʌŋ ˈflæʃɪz ˈaʊt wɛn ɪt ˈkætʃɪz ˈɪnsɛkts ɪn ðə ˈpɑnd/
